ev.q: Among 22 patients (from three studies) with available virologic data and who received treatment, median time to negative test results was 6 days
Pearson’s chi-square or Fisher’s exact test were used to compare proportions for studies that did not report the test statistic.
Median time to viral rebound was 9 days (IQR = 9–13 days) after diagnosis
Pearson’s chi-square or Fisher’s exact test were used to compare proportions for studies that did not report the test statistic.
Viral rebound rates were similar between patients with and without antiviral treatment
The Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses were used

methods_quotes.q: Individual case data from three studies that used the same definition of viral rebound were examined to estimate days to onset of viral rebound and rebound duration
Median days to rebound and resolution of acute and rebound illness were calculated.
Pearson’s chi-square or Fisher’s exact test were used to compare proportions for studies that did not report the test statistic.
